limits: Every frozen callback case and the six retained velocity/cache updates are preserved. Actual JNI and external numeric targets are checked at invocation. The original numeric dispatch and arithmetic bodies execute until their endpoints.

The external double numeric engine remains unresolved. The fixture hypothesis for baseline calls is not a production implementation; explicit result words are also tested. JNI semantics, initialization, ownership, registration, concurrency and floating modes remain unverified.
The instruction ledger records unexecuted transitive helper paths; full callback instruction coverage is not exhaustive value coverage. Typed UI/settings need their own evidence.
